scope: Independent adversarial data audit (DA12) of three current dossiers: USB, PPG, GDDY. 21 load-bearing facts checked (7/7/7 by ticker), selected for the claims most likely to break a thesis or a kill criterion if wrong: headline quarterly figures, guidance track records, capital/credit ratios, debt/leverage and balance-sheet items, litigation exposure, and buyback/capital-return figures. Special attention paid to USB's consolidated U.S. Bancorp vs U.S. Bank N.A. subsidiary scoping for every capital ratio and to ROE vs ROTCE definitions (per task instructions), and to the dossier_precheck.json-flagged lines (period labels, entity scope, citations without accession numbers) for all three tickers. Method: primary sources only -- SEC EDGAR 8-K Ex-99.1 earnings-release exhibits, 10-Q/10-K text and XBRL rendered (R#.htm) exhibits, and data.sec.gov XBRL companyfacts/submissions -- fetched directly from www.sec.gov and data.sec.gov and cited by accession/URL below; CFPB enforcement-action status and earnings-call-date claims cross-checked via WebSearch against consumerfinance.gov, bankingdive.com and ir.usbank.com. Each dossier was read to its end (no appended Correction sections were found on any of the three). Each ticker's one-line thesis and first kill criterion were checked for consistency with the underlying filings; results noted in the summary (see da12_factcheck.md section 4).

facts.claim: Balance sheet, 30-Jun-2026 (consolidated, 10-Q accession 0000079879-26-000252): cash $1,520m (down from $2,163m at 31-Dec-2025); long-term debt (carrying value) $6,876m + short-term debt/current portion $691m => total debt ~$7.57bn; net debt ~$6.05bn; total shareholders' equity $8,590m (up from $8,097m)
facts.source: PPG 10-Q, quarter ended 30-Jun-2026, accession 0000079879-26-000252, R5.htm (Condensed Consolidated Balance Sheet)
facts.source_value: "Cash and cash equivalents": $1,520M (Jun-26) / $2,163M (Dec-25); "Short-term debt and current portion of long-term debt": $691M / $706M; "Long-term debt": $6,195M / $6,602M; "Total shareholders' equity": $8,590M / $8,097M
facts.note: Cash, short-term debt and total shareholders' equity all match exactly, but long-term debt is misstated: the 10-Q's own balance sheet (R5.htm) reports long-term debt of $6,195m at 30-Jun-2026, not $6,876m as the dossier states -- a $681m (~11%) overstatement. Correct total debt is 691+6,195 = $6,886m (~$6.89bn, not $7.57bn), and correct net debt is 6,886-1,520 = $5,366m (~$5.37bn, not $6.05bn). Directionally this makes PPG's leverage somewhat better than stated: net debt/EBITDA on the corrected $5.37bn net debt figure would be lower than the ~2.2x quoted from the quant card (which appears to be built off a different/consistent EBITDA base), so kill criterion 3 (net debt/EBITDA >3.0x) is not affected in direction, but the raw dollar figures feeding this kill criterion are factually wrong and should be corrected.
